system

user

Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**FADE IN:**

**INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY**

The camera pans across a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all stands 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is presented with a certificate and a gold medal, and the crowd erupts in applause.

**JASPER** (overcome with emotion)
Oh, Thank You! I'm Truly Honored!

**REPORTER 1**
Mr. Jenkins, this is a momentous occasion. You've shattered the record for the Oldest Human to Ever Live. How does it feel?

**JASPER**
It's...it's Just Incredible. I'm Still In Shock.

**CUT TO:**

**INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT**

Jasper lies in bed, the gold medal and certificate displayed proudly on his nightstand. He gazes at the ceiling, a faraway look in his eyes.

**JASPER (V.O.)**
I Remember Reading About This Theory Online, Back In My Youth. Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Were Born In A Universe With A Multiverse, There Was A Chance That You Would Survive Every Possible Outcome Of Every Event. That You Would Be The Only One To Make It Through.

**JASPER (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
I Never Thought Much Of It At The Time. Just A Crazy Idea From Some Guy On The Internet. But Now...Now I'm Not So Sure.

**JASPER (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
What If I'm Not Just Jasper Jenkins? What If I'm...What If I'm A Branch Of A Larger Tree? A Leaf On A Cosmic Tree? What If Every Time I Died, I Was Reborn In A Different Universe?

**JASPER (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
Oh God, Oh God, Oh God...

**JASPER (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
I'M NOT JUST JASPER JENKINS! I'M EVERY JASPER JENKINS! I'M EVERY POSSIBLE JASPER JENKINS!

**JASPER (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
I'M THE SUM OF ALL POSSIBILITIES! I'M THE UNIVERSE ITSELF!

**JASPER (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
NO, NO, NO! STOP IT! STOP IT RIGHT NOW!

**JASPER (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
I'M NOT SUPPOSED TO KNOW THIS! I'M NOT SUPPOSED TO KNOW THE TRUTH!

**JASPER (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
I'M GOING MAD! I'M GOING MAD!

**JASPER (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
I'M...I'M...I'M...

**JASPER (V.O.) (CONT'D)**
(Maniacal laughter echoes through the room as Jasper's mind unravels)

**FADE TO BLACK.**
